about: Every role a CHAOSS user story ('As a <role>, ...') or a decision prompt names, mapped to the Foundation stakeholders who hold it. A role matches its longest listed phrase that is the whole role or its first words. A role no phrase matches is a typed refusal and an open claim, never a guess. why cites the source sentence that makes the mapping.
